name: ASK Automotive Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1988, ASK Automotive Limited is a manufacturer of Advance Braking Systems for two-wheelers in India.[1]
keyPoints: Market Leadership[1] Ask Automotive is the largest manufacturer of brake-shoe and advanced braking (AB) systems for two-wheelers in India. The company had a market share of 50% in FY24 in terms of production volume for OEMs and the branded independent aftermarket (IAM)

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 18.4% CAGR over last 5 years
Debtor days have improved from 25.3 to 19.8 days.
cons: Stock is trading at 8.11 times its book value
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
